instruction: Display the playoff bracket for the 2021 season.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com homepage to the 2021 playoff bracket/picture page. Uses existing evaluator function is_expected_url_pattern_match to verify the URL matches the 2021 playoff bracket pattern. Similar navigation complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction by checking if user navigated to the 2021 NFL playoff bracket page
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) extracts the right state - active Chrome tab URL
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly compares URL against expected regex pattern
Expected URL pattern 'https://www\.nfl\.com/playoffs/playoff-picture/2021' semantically matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage - URL verification is sufficient to confirm the playoff bracket page is displayed
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string → metric applies regex matching → returns 1.0 if pattern matches
Edge cases handled properly (empty URL returns 0.0)
No parameter handling issues - expected.type='rule' so rules dict is passed directly to metric
Metric logic correctly handles both string URLs and dict results with 'url' field
